definitions.gloss: company culture; corporate climate; organizational atmosphere
definitions.explanation: The distinctive atmosphere, shared values, and working style that characterize a particular company. Often discussed by job seekers when judging whether a workplace will suit them.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社風|しゃふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧だ。
examples.english: This company has a free-spirited corporate culture.

examples.japanese: {社風|しゃふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Whether the company culture suits you or not is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{社風|しゃふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{確|たし}かめた→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: In an interview, you should carefully check the company's corporate culture.

notes:
Written with ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ (company) + {風|ふう} (style, manner). Refers to the intangible character of a workplace rather than its formal rules.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社風|しゃふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: the company culture suits one
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧な{社風|しゃふう}: a free, open corporate culture
- {社風|しゃふう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧なじむ: to fit into the company culture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: corporate culture — broader and more formal, often used in management writing
- {家風|かふう}: family customs — the same {風|ふう} applied to a household rather than a company
